brief:
Public anger over the Gaza conflict has significantly weakened AIPAC's influence, Shehab Wire reported, transforming support for Israeli occupation into an electoral liability. The pro-Israel lobby's unprecedented decline reflects growing grassroots opposition to the war, which has shifted the political calculus around funding and advocacy related to the conflict.

The shift opens new opportunities for opponents of AIPAC's financing model, according to the report. The organization's traditional grip on Democratic and Republican support appears to be fracturing as voter sentiment on Gaza reshapes electoral considerations.

title: Gaza War Erodes AIPAC's Political Dominance in US Elections
